issues: With İSTATİSTİK now added as a top-row tab (admin), the tabs wrap to 2 lines at 1920px — 'İŞ KOLLARI' visibly overlaps 'YETKİLER' on line 2. Cosmetic only, all tabs remain clickable. Same overflow issue was flagged in iteration_53 for the Companies subtab layout.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Consider wrapping the top settings tab bar with better responsive layout or icon-only compression at 1920px+ — İSTATİSTİK addition pushed İŞ KOLLARI onto a 2nd row that visually overlaps YETKİLER.
critical_code_review_comments: monitoring_service.build_health_snapshot: `last_login_at` filter uses ISO string comparison against day_ago iso — works as long as last_login_at is always stored as ISO string in the same UTC format. If any code path writes datetime objects there, count could silently miss rows. Consider normalizing to a single type in the writer or using a $gte with datetime.

monitoring_service.ErrorCounter: `windowed` recomputes by scanning all events on every snapshot. With deque maxlen=1000 this is fine, but if window_hours < deque churn window some older-but-in-deque events may still be counted after cutoff — currently safe because cutoff filter is explicit, so no bug, just noted for future.
MonitoringDashboard.jsx: 30-second interval refresh is fine, but there's no visibility-change pause — auto-refresh keeps firing while tab hidden. Low priority.

NotificationBell pref panel: when Notification.permission === 'denied', the panel shows only the deny message with no manual override path (correct browser behavior, but users need explicit guidance to unblock in browser settings). Copy is already helpful.
